headline: Palantine and Linn Mercy Lines Renew Activity
war_summary: Since the last edition, the Palantine Berm front has come sharply back to life, recording four strategic-base events in the latest two hours and twenty-six across the day; its ledger now shows five Colonial and two Warden bases. Linn Mercy has also resumed movement, with three events in two hours and eight in six, while its count stands at ten Colonial, one neutral, and no Warden bases—one fewer Warden holding than previously reported. Mooring County, formerly the busiest immediate sector, has fallen silent in the latest two hours, though three events in six and twenty-seven in twenty-four keep its twelve Warden bases under watch. Weathered Expanse remains a broad, hard-fought theater with thirty-four daily base events and two neutral positions, but no fresh event in the latest six hours. Marban Hollow’s divided line still shows four Colonial, three Warden, and one neutral base after twenty events in the day, though its latest six hours are quiet. Gutter, meanwhile, has posted three events in six hours around its six-to-one Warden majority. The war remains without a declared victor.
